reviewGroups.rule: Keep the latest authoritative instructions; archive superseded copies only after dependency checks.
Never remove a test that still protects an active runtime invariant.
Archive superseded documentation; retain current security and backend contracts.
Remove only when a verified optimized replacement is active and visual equivalence is proven.
Trace HTML, JavaScript, CSS and service-worker references before classifying any version as inactive.

mandatoryProcedureBeforeDeletion: Build a byte-for-byte backup of origin/main.
Resolve the complete active dependency graph.
Compare duplicate candidates by SHA-256 and content.
Prove that no HTML, JavaScript, CSS, manifest or service worker references the candidate.
Run Tarot, Library, Consultations, School and PWA regression tests.
Request explicit owner authorization for the exact deletion list.
Delete in a reversible release with rollback instructions.
